tasks.label: init-orb-git
tasks.command: git init; git add .; git commit -m "Initial commit"; git branch -M main; git remote add origin https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/ORB.git; git status -sb; git remote -v

tasks.label: commit-orb-git-with-local-identity
tasks.command: git config user.name Caitl; git config user.email caitl@local.invalid; git commit -m initial_commit; git status -sb; git remote -v; git log --oneline -n 1

tasks.label: push-orb-to-caitlyn-repo
tasks.command: git remote set-url origin https://github.com/caitlynrandels-del/ORB; git remote -v; git push -u origin main

tasks.label: rebase-and-push-orb
tasks.command: git pull --rebase origin main; git push -u origin main

tasks.label: commit-one-window-launcher
tasks.command: git add open_product.bat open_product.ps1 ORB/App.html; git commit -m one_click_single_window_product_launcher; git push; git log --oneline -n 1; git status -sb

tasks.label: commit-review-driven-redesign
tasks.command: git add core/oroboro_mind.py language/interpreter.py api_server.py ORB/App.html docs/product/01-v1-prd.md docs/product/00-investor-packet.md; git commit -m review_driven_confidence_loop_and_flagship_redesign; git push; git log --oneline -n 1; git status -sb

tasks.label: commit-sproutlab-product
tasks.command: git add ORB/SproutLab.html ORB/App.html; git commit -m sproutlab_npc_sentience_science_app; git push; git log --oneline -n 1; git status -sb
